- [ES2016a:09:32] The remote will sell for 25 Euro.
- [ES2016a:19:36] The team will not create a ball shaped remote.
- [ES2016b:22:11] The remote will only be used for televisions.
- [ES2016b:22:42] The team will not work with teletext.
- [ES2016b:22:52] The corporate color and slogan must be incorporated into the design.
- [ES2016b:23:37] The remote will be simple.
- [ES2016b:23:35] The remote will look appealing.
- [ES2016b:23:40] The remote will be easy to find.
- [ES2016b:26:49] The remote will have a minimal number of buttons.
- [ES2016b:29:13] The remote will be yellow with black or gray buttons.

- [ES2016b:31:57] The remote will have buttons for numbers, volume up and down, channel up and down, power, mute, and a menu.
- [ES2016b:32:58] The remote will include a scroll action.
- [ES2016b:39:18] The remote will be rounded in shape such that it fits comfortably in the hand.
- [ES2016c:33:34] The remote will use conventional batteries.
- [ES2016c:34:50] The case will be made of plastic with rubber grips.
